title: Spikers' Turf: Alpha Insurance turns back ClearSkiiin, extends win streak
summary: Alpha Insurance scored a tough four-set win over ClearSkiiin, 26-24, 16-25, 25-19, 25-21, in the 2026 Spikers' Turf Invitational Conference on Sunday night at the Filoil EcoOil Centre.
